title: Google Self-Driving Car on City Streets
summary: A two-minute Google video of its self-driving car handling city street scenarios near the Googleplex. It shows the car dealing with cyclists, pedestrians, construction and a railroad crossing.
why: Cited as concrete footage of what Google's autonomous cars could do in 2014 when the feasibility of driverless cars was being debated.

quote.text: This video shows how the Google self-driving cars react to cyclists, as well as obstacles on the road and such
